metadata.description: The auteur skill: websites directed like films, gated by an executable anti-slop linter.

plugins.name: auteur
plugins.description: Design and build complete, distinctive web experiences — award-level product pages, cinematic scroll-directed sites, and multi-screen products as one design system. Art direction is committed before any markup, assets come from local CLIs, and nothing ships until it passes the anti-slop and motion gates.
